remarks:
Experience lakefront living at its finest on this 1.27 acre property featuring 182" shoreline on beautiful Findley Lake.  The professionally installed concrete block retaining wall was completed in 2025.  Built in 2006, this spacious ranch offers 4 bedrooms and 3 full baths.  The primary bedroom is ensuite, while 3 additional bedrooms share a full bath with a walk-in shower.  A third bath is conveniently located near the main entrance and Great Room.  The Great Room, added in 2016 and affectionally known as the "Fish-
Bowl", has 180 degree breathtaking lake views.  The Great Room is anchored by a versatile fireplace, enjoyed as either woodburning or gas fired.  In-floor radiant heat and a dedicated mini-split system provide year-round comfort.  The open-concept kitchen flows into the Great Room and is designed for entertaining.  A large island features two deep sinks, a gas cooktop, abundant workspace and seating for 4.  Opposite the island is a double wall convection oven, a refrigerator, extensive cabinetry offering functionality and storage.  Outdoor living is equally impressive.  The covered front porch overlooks the lake and provides perfect, spectacular sunsets.  The covered side porch seats 12 plus, comfortably and features a built-in pizza oven.  A well-designed patio next to the side porch offers a gas fire pit and grilling
area, providing an inviting extension of the home's entertaining spaces, making a perfect setting for lakeside evenings.  The clean, well maintained 4' crawl space is accessible through the 3rd bath. The oversized garage includes a half bath and a floored, unfinished second story.  A detached single garage is convenient for year-round storage.  Whether you're searching for a full-time residence or the perfect lakefront retreat, this property offers outstanding comfort, recreation and natural beauty. Conveniently located 2 hours from Cleveland and Pittsburgh, a half hour to Erie and close to year-round activities.  Golf, skiing, hiking, biking and wineries are all within minutes.  This is a rare opportunity to own a truly complete waterfront property where peaceful lake living meets endless recreation and million dollar views.
